properties.name: simplydone4j.scheduler.enabled
properties.description: Enable the scheduler engine and worker maintenance services. Set to false for submission-only nodes that delegate job execution elsewhere.

properties.name: simplydone4j.scheduler.polling-interval-ms
properties.description: Polling interval for the scheduler in milliseconds.

properties.name: simplydone4j.scheduler.queue-prefix
properties.description: Redis key prefix for queue sorted sets.

properties.name: simplydone4j.scheduler.weights.high
properties.description: Weight for high-priority queue in deficit round-robin.

properties.name: simplydone4j.scheduler.weights.normal
properties.description: Weight for normal-priority queue in deficit round-robin.

properties.name: simplydone4j.scheduler.weights.low
properties.description: Weight for low-priority queue in deficit round-robin.

properties.name: simplydone4j.rate-limit.requests-per-minute
properties.description: Maximum requests per minute per producer.

properties.name: simplydone4j.rate-limit.window-seconds
properties.description: Rate limit sliding window in seconds.

properties.name: simplydone4j.retry.max-attempts
properties.description: Maximum retry attempts before job moves to DLQ.

properties.name: simplydone4j.retry.initial-delay-seconds
properties.description: Initial delay before first retry in seconds.

properties.name: simplydone4j.retry.backoff-multiplier
properties.description: Exponential backoff multiplier for retry delays.

properties.name: simplydone4j.worker.lease-timeout-seconds
properties.description: Lease timeout for running jobs in seconds.

properties.name: simplydone4j.worker.retry-promoter-interval-ms
properties.description: Interval for promoting retry-scheduled jobs back to queue.

properties.name: simplydone4j.worker.lease-reaper-interval-ms
properties.description: Interval for recovering expired leases.

properties.name: simplydone4j.queue.max-depth
properties.description: Maximum total queue depth across all priorities.

properties.name: simplydone4j.executor.core-pool-size
properties.description: Core thread pool size for job execution.

properties.name: simplydone4j.executor.max-pool-size
properties.description: Maximum thread pool size for job execution.

properties.name: simplydone4j.executor.queue-capacity
properties.description: Executor work queue capacity.

properties.name: simplydone4j.executor.keep-alive-seconds
properties.description: Keep-alive time for idle threads in seconds.

properties.name: simplydone4j.executor.default-timeout-seconds
properties.description: Default timeout for job handler execution.

properties.name: simplydone4j.executor.await-termination-seconds
properties.description: Seconds to wait for thread pool to terminate on shutdown.

properties.name: simplydone4j.key-prefix
properties.description: Global Redis key prefix for all SimplyDone4J data.

properties.name: simplydone4j.ttl-days
properties.description: TTL in days for finished (success/failed/DLQ/cancelled) job data.

properties.name: simplydone4j.idempotency-ttl-hours
properties.description: TTL in hours for idempotency lock entries.

properties.name: simplydone4j.monitoring.enabled
properties.description: Enable the monitoring service.
